an3.94:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve ādicco nabhaṃ abbhussukkamāno sabbaṃ ākāsagataṃ tamaṃ abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca,
an3.94:2.1: evam eva kho bhikkhave yato ariyasāvakassa virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi sahadassanuppādā bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa tīṇi saṃyojanāni pahīyanti
an3.94:3.1: athāparaṃ dvīhi dhammehi niyyāti abhijjhāya ca vyāpādena ca.
an3.94:3.2: So vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an3.94:3.3: Tasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye ariyasāvako kālaṃ kareyya n' atthi taṃ saṃyojanaṃ yena saṃyojanena saṃyutto ariyasāvako puna imaṃ lokaṃ āgaccheyyā
